hi! i'm katt, also known as kaleidoscopikatt, and i'm a backend developer, wherein i focus primarily on software development. lots of the projects i make are based on modding resources and personal software for ease-of-use in my own activities, such as game development or language development.

my very first project that I have records of making dates back to september of 2016, and i've loved programming from then on. since then, i've been working on modding programs for games such as Star Wars: Empire at War, Hearts of Iron IV, Stellaris, etc. - as well as making a minor suggestion to the Fabric API for modding Minecraft. i've also developed mods of my own, and software seperate to modding as well, like minor apps for more advanced shapes with vinyl cutting, CAD, and automating and displaying data, such as sorting or searching algorithms for small and large data. alongside this, i've created programming languages, proprietary 2D game engines, and much more!
